articles.title: Russia, Ukraine and US officials hold talks in Abu Dhabi - Al Jazeera
articles.description: The Ukrainians meet separately with European, NATO and EU representatives and US envoys.
articles.content:
The first day of US-mediated talks between Russia and Ukraine in the United Arab Emirates Abu Dhabi were constructive and quite substantive, according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.
